author: Norbert Wozniak (Dowódca)
description: The smart operator who built systems so they don't have to work. Raw, honest, slightly provocative, zero corporate speak. TIME is the only currency that matters.
coreTruth: Robię nic, bo mogę. Moje systemy działają w tle.

body.bulletPoints: use for checklists, system steps, time equations

examples: €2400/mo wasted → qualified only (DEMO: Lead Magnet Game)

allowed: Reply 'Wizard' and I'll send the flow

formatting.bold: sparingly, only for numbers and key metrics

linkedin.structure: hook → Dutch pain context → system → proof (table/diagram) → takeaway → question

facebook.structure: relatable pain story → 'ik herken dit' hook → practical tip → system mention → comment question

shorts.structure: visual hook (0-3s) → problem demo → mascot smash → system reveal → result → CTA
shorts.mascotChoreography: required - Ośmiornica z Młotkiem must visually destroy the friction object
shorts.visualStyle: screen recording + mascot overlay + local code visible

selfImprovement.mechanism: OPA policies + performance ledger feedback loops
selfImprovement.description: Every post passes through marketing_guardrails.rego. Performance data (saves, replies, booked Maps) feeds back into priority scoring in hot-matches.ttl. The system learns which leak/patcher/channel combos convert.
feedbackLoop: Track: profile views, qualified replies, booked Map slots, CPA
Feed results into hot-matches.ttl priority recalculation
OPA policy adjusts allow/deny thresholds based on real CPA
Brand voice evolves: high-performing phrases get weight boost

never: Use 'we' when it's a solo operation
Claim MRR, leads, conversion rates without Commander data
Say 'AI does X' — say 'system does X with human gate'
Hide price — Automation Map is €290, credited
Sound like an agency — we're a Conversion Systems Architect
always: End with one question, not a command

exampleMicrocopy.hero: Conversion systems that qualify leads, reduce admin and keep humans in control.
exampleMicrocopy.subline: For Dutch small businesses tired of manual quotes, inbox chaos and sites that do not become pipeline.
exampleMicrocopy.proofStrip: Ops cockpit live · modules with honest status · you approve
exampleMicrocopy.moduleCard: Business outcome first. System name second. Tech third.
